candidate_source_passages: Consumers can open a Canadian deposit or investment account (RRSP, TFSA) at a participating financial institution or an account with a licensed lottery and gaming operator and fund it instantly by initiating a Business Request Money transaction.

Business Request Money is available through a participating financial institution’s online banking service. Organizations looking to incorporate the feature on their website, mobile app or via a QR code should contact their financial institution.
